w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 3 raiders (The Redactor, The Big Stare, The Landlord) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group

w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: It followed you. The Spool is here.

w5Mentions.name: The Rerun
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
firstContext: 🐗 This one came with the raid on Haven — it was with the teeth at the door, not a lone wanderer.
📼 RERUN ×1 — you have seen this episode. It has seen you too. (Overtime: +25% HP, +12% damage.)
You lock eyes and don't look away. It falters — then backs off, disengaging. Smart. (Stare Down — it backed down.)
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Loud-Eyes." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (17/14/8), with 6 wave-4 fought, 13 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 13 · Craft 10 · Talk 21 · Explore 32 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Rosa Mendez ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.
⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,233 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.

✨ CAPSTONE: Phase Shawl. Sometimes your shoulder isn't where the spear lands. The shawl knows. Don't ask how. It was never going to drop from a monster. It was always going to be GIVEN — to someone who'd earned the shape of it.
